description: Malaysian statutory registration, exemption, and compliance thresholds for SST and MyInvois e-invoicing
sources: Inland Revenue Board of Malaysia (LHDN), https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/e-invoice/

thresholds.label: Standard Sales Tax Rate
thresholds.description: Standard 10% sales tax on taxable manufactured or imported goods

thresholds.label: Reduced Sales Tax Rate
thresholds.description: Reduced 5% sales tax on specific scheduled basic foodstuffs and building materials

thresholds.label: Sales Tax Registration Threshold (MYR)
thresholds.description: Annual taxable manufactured sales exceeding RM 500,000 mandates registration under Sales Tax Act 2018

thresholds.label: General Service Tax Rate
thresholds.description: General service tax rate of 8% pursuant to Service Tax (Rate of Tax) (Amendment) Regulations 2024

thresholds.label: Food & Beverage Service Tax Rate
thresholds.description: Preserved 6% service tax rate for food and beverage operators (Group B)

thresholds.label: General Service Tax Registration Threshold (MYR)
thresholds.description: Annual value of prescribed taxable services exceeding RM 500,000 mandates registration

thresholds.label: F&B Operators Service Tax Registration Threshold (MYR)
thresholds.description: Annual turnover exceeding RM 1,500,000 for restaurant and catering operators (Group B)

thresholds.label: MyInvois E-Invoicing Phase 4 Cut-off (MYR)
thresholds.description: LHDN MyInvois Phase 4 mandate for businesses with annual turnover of RM 1M to RM 5M starting 1 Jan 2026

thresholds.label: MyInvois Micro-Business Exemption Ceiling (MYR)
thresholds.description: Businesses with annual revenue below RM 1,000,000 are exempt from mandatory e-invoicing transmission

thresholds.label: MyInvois Rejection and Cancellation Window (Hours)
thresholds.description: 72-hour window from validation for buyer rejection or supplier cancellation of a validated e-invoice
